name: Nura Glass Tip Pre-Roll | Animal Face
description:
A hand rolled 1 gram joint with a glass tip filter to ensure a smooth and flavorful smoking experience.

Animal Face is a sativa-dominant strain, originally bred by the Washington-based brand From the Soil farms.

The top reported aromas are mint and earth, and the top reported flavors are pine and diesel.
